basic_details.short_information: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB) has released a set of notifications on 29th July 2026 inviting online applications for direct recruitment to multiple posts in the Telangana Police, Special Protection Force, Fire Services, and Prisons departments. Together, these notifications cover 325 vacancies across seven post categories. Applications will be accepted only through the online mode on the official TSLPRB website, www.tgprb.in.

how_to_apply: Visit the official TSLPRB website: www.tgprb.in
Register using your mobile number as the User ID.
Select the notification(s) and post(s) you wish to apply for.
Note the applicable fee and complete payment via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.
Log in and fill in Part-I of the Application Form.
Scan and upload your passport-size photograph and specimen signature as a single JPG file (30 KB-100 KB).
Review all entries, confirm via OTP sent to your registered mobile number, and submit Part-I.
Download and print the generated Part-I application form in PDF.

Candidates who qualify the Preliminary Written Test (SI Civil/RSI/SPF SI/SFO/Deputy Jailor group) - or, for PC Mechanic/Driver and ASI FPB (which have no Preliminary Written Test), at the appropriate later stage - must revisit the website to submit Part-II along with scanned certificates/documents.
Download and retain a copy of the final submitted form for future reference.

Note: Candidates should not register more than one application form, since a single registration collects information across the linked notifications (Rc. Nos. 189, 225, 234, and 279 of 2026, all dated 29-07-2026).
important_instructions: Applications are accepted online only; TSLPRB is not responsible for discrepancies in online submissions. No column in the application form should be left blank; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Once submitted, no corrections can be made to the application form. Furnishing false, tampered, or fabricated information leads to disqualification and possible prosecution. Selection at every stage is purely provisional and confers no right to final selection. There is no waiting list; fallout vacancies are treated as lapsed for that recruitment cycle. Age validation is not automatic; candidates must independently verify their own eligibility. Candidates should get a medical fitness self-check (eyesight, physical standards) done from a Civil Surgeon before applying. Provisionally selected candidates are appointed to regular posts only after successful completion of training. Rely only on official TSLPRB website updates, not on rumours or unverified social media information.

Candidates who hold a graduate degree and are exploring opportunities beyond TSLPRB can also check the latest Graduate Government Jobs and Telangana Government Jobs available across departments. Those interested in uniformed and defence-related careers can browse more Police and Defence Jobs, while candidates open to opportunities in neighbouring states can explore Andhra Pradesh Government Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notifications state that OC and BC candidates with local status of Telangana State must pay the fee "as designated in the Online Application," while SC and ST local candidates pay a concessional fee. Exact fee amounts in rupees are not specified in any of the notifications - the applicable fee will be displayed on the TSLPRB online portal based on the candidate's category and the post(s)/notification(s) applied for. Candidates applying for more than one post among the linked technical notifications (SI Civil, RSI, SPF SI, SFO, Deputy Jailor, ASI FPB, PC Civil, PC Mechanic, PC Driver) issued within 3 months of each other are eligible for a fee rebate on the common Physical Measurement Test/Physical Efficiency Test: ₹50 per additional post (in excess of 1) for Local SC/ST candidates of Telangana ₹100 per additional post (in excess of 1) for all other candidates Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances, including under-age/over-age applications or incomplete submissions.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection stages differ slightly depending on the post group. Preliminary Written Test (PWT): One objective paper, 3 hours - Arithmetic & Test of Reasoning/Mental Ability (100 questions) and General Studies (100 questions), 200 marks total. Qualifying marks: 30% OC/EWS, 25% BC, 20% SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen. Physical Measurement Test (PMT) / Physical Efficiency Test (PET): 1600m run (Men)/800m run (Women), height measurement, Long Jump/Shot-put. The run is qualifying only for Post Codes 11, 17, 18, 19, while it carries marks for Post Codes 12, 13, 14, 16. Final Written Examination (FWE): Four papers of 3 hours each - English, Telugu/Urdu (both qualifying), Arithmetic & Test of Reasoning/Mental Ability, and General Studies. Qualifying marks: 40% OC/EWS, 35% BC, 30% SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen per paper. Certificates Verification. Final Written Examination Pattern: Papers I and II are qualifying only. Final merit for Post Codes 11, 17, 18, 19 is based on Papers III + IV; for Post Codes 12, 13, 14, 16, both the FWE score and the normalized PET run-event score count. PMT/PET (common stage, see table below). Trade Test (Mechanic) / Driving Test (Driver): 100 marks across 10 (Mechanic) or 8 (Driver) technical parameters. Minimum 50 marks overall, with a minimum of 5 marks in each parameter; failing 3 or more parameters disqualifies even if the aggregate minimum is met. Written Examination: Objective Technical Paper, 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours. Certificate Verification. Final selection is based on the aggregate of the Trade Test/Driving Test and the Written Examination. Qualifying marks in the Written Examination: 40% OC/EWS, 35% BC, 30% SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen. PMT/PET (common stage, see table below). Written Examination: Paper I is qualifying only; final merit is based on Paper II + Paper III. Qualifying marks: 40% OC/EWS, 35% BC, 30% SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen. Certificate Verification. PMT/PET conducted for one TSLPRB notification within a 3-month window is valid across all other TSLPRB notifications the same candidate applies for - it is not repeated. Selection at every stage (admission to exam, merit list inclusion, hall ticket issuance) is purely provisional. There is no waiting list; fallout vacancies from cancelled provisional selections lapse for that recruitment cycle.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Standard categories apply: BC-A, BC-B, BC-C, BC-D, BC-E, SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, Meritorious Sports Persons (MSP), and EWS, per Rule 22 of the Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules, 1996. Women's Reservation (ASI FPB and applicable SI-group posts): 33⅓% horizontal reservation across all categories, including EWS. Special Category Quotas - PC Mechanic: 10% Home Guards, 3% Children of Police Personnel (CPP), 1% NCC. Special Category Quotas - PC Driver: 20% Home Guards, 3% CPP, 1% NCC. Local Reservation (ASI FPB): 95% of vacancies in each Contiguous Zonal Cadre are filled from Local Candidates of the respective zones under the 2018 Local Cadres Order.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are there in TSLPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 325 vacancies in total: 275 for SI Civil/RSI/SPF SI/Station Fire Officer/Deputy Jailor, 27 for PC Mechanic and PC Driver combined, and 23 for ASI, Fingerprint Bureau.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TSLPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Exact application dates have not been announced yet. TSLPRB will release these through a separate Press Release on www.tgprb.in.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit across TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: 21–25 years (as on 1st July 2026) for SI Civil, RSI, SPF SI, SFO, Deputy Jailor, and ASI FPB; 18–22 years for PC Mechanic and PC Driver. An additional 5-year relaxation applies for uniformed services, plus further category-based relaxations.

faq.question: Q4. Are women eligible for all TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Women are eligible for SI Civil, RSI (AR), SPF SI, Station Fire Officer, Deputy Jailor (Women), and ASI Fingerprint Bureau. PC Mechanic and PC Driver posts are open to men only, and Deputy Jailor (Women) and RSI (SAR CPL/TGSP)/Deputy Jailor (Men) are gender-specific as noted above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required across posts?
faq.answer: A degree (any discipline, UGC-recognized) for SI Civil/RSI/SPF SI/Deputy Jailor; the same plus an LMV licence for Station Fire Officer; SSC + ITI or Intermediate + HPMV/HGV licence for PC Driver; SSC + ITI for PC Mechanic; and a B.E./B.Tech in IT/CS (or related) or B.Sc. in CS/Computer Applications for ASI Fingerprint Bureau.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for TSLPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SI Civil/RSI/SPF SI/SFO/Deputy Jailor: Preliminary Written Test → PMT/PET → Final Written Examination → Certificate Verification. PC Mechanic/Driver and ASI FPB have no Preliminary Written Test: PMT/PET → Trade/Driving Test (or directly Written Examination for ASI FPB) → Certificate Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for TSLPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact fee is not disclosed in the notifications; it varies by category (OC/BC, SC/ST) and will be shown on the online application portal at www.tgprb.in.

faq.question: Q8. Can a candidate apply for more than one TSLPRB post in this recruitment cycle?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates can apply for multiple posts among the linked notifications (SI Civil, RSI, SPF SI, SFO, Deputy Jailor, ASI FPB, PC Civil, PC Mechanic, PC Driver — all dated 29-07-2026) and are eligible for a PMT/PET fee rebate on additional posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale across TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: SI Civil/RSI/SPF SI: ₹42,300–1,15,270. Station Fire Officer/Deputy Jailor: ₹38,890–1,12,510. ASI Fingerprint Bureau: ₹33,750–99,310. PC Mechanic/PC Driver: ₹24,280–72,850.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a Preliminary Written Test for all posts?
faq.answer: No. Only the SI Civil, RSI, SPF SI, Station Fire Officer, and Deputy Jailor posts have a Preliminary Written Test. PC Mechanic, PC Driver, and ASI Fingerprint Bureau do not.
